description: VIRCAM is the near-infrared camera of VISTA. These bands are the broad-band Z, Y, J, H and Ks filters and the narrow-band NB980, NB990 and NB118 filters carried in the camera.
facility_description: VISTA is a 4 m wide-field survey telescope at ESO's Cerro Paranal Observatory, on a peak near the VLT.
notes: Licence is unknown for the numeric filter tables. The quoted sentence is the public-website exclusion: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 there covers images, videos, music and specified press texts, not these curves. The ESO Science Archive data-access policy (https://archive.eso.org/cms/eso-data-access-policy.html) says archive data files are distributed under CC BY 4.0; that sentence was not shown to cover the instrument-page transmission files. Publication footnotes that require an ESO programme identifier were not copied, because no programme is known. The instrument page lists Z 0.88 µm, Y 1.02 µm, J 1.25 µm, H 1.65 µm, Ks 2.15 µm, NB980 0.98 µm, NB990 0.99 µm and NB118 1.18 µm, and offers a tar of the plotted curves. NB980 and NB990 share one filter slot. The ADS links on the summary page, bibcode:2006Msngr.126...41E and bibcode:2006SPIE.6269E..30D, did not resolve and were omitted. No other VISTA paper was opened.
